name: Ring of Falling Stars
body:
Aura strong evocation; CL 12th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of shooting stars and will act as such most of the time. Any time the functions of the ring are used there is a 30% base chance of the wearer being the target of a meteor as per the meteor swarm spell. The meteor has a +10 bonus to its touch attack and all individuals within 40 feet of the wearer suffer 2d6 points of damage unless they make a DC 21 Reflex save for half damage.

Each additional use of the ring per day increases the base chance by 10%.

This ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of shooting stars

Identification DC 37
False Identification DC 27
